first.speaker: FIXER
pages: Another ghost. Sit.
Noodles are free for the dead.
Registry pulled your key? Then nobody on this street sees you.
Got a name, ghost? Your deck has a keyboard. Type it.

handle.speaker: FIXER
pages: Name first. Your deck, the keyboard: set handle, then the name.

greet.speaker: FIXER
pages: {player:name}. Fine name for a nobody.
House rule: hints cost a bowl. Answers aren't on the menu.
You're broke, though. And my till still runs on factory settings. Don't tell anyone.

till.speaker: FIXER
pages: The till is right there. Factory settings. Every manual prints them.

gloves.speaker: FIXER
pages: Two gloves. Left and right. Let me see.
Moth's gloves. Moth loses one of everything.
Keys, gloves, sleep, flats. Never a friend, though. Eat something.

box-hint-0.speaker: FIXER
pages: That junction box under the VERIFY sign belongs to the Registry. Older than you.
One bowl. Here:
Signs on this street never fully light. Read what the one above the box really says.

box-hint-1.speaker: FIXER
pages: That junction box under the VERIFY sign belongs to the Registry. Older than you.
One bowl. Here:
The box only takes maintenance logins. It says so itself, if you ask it to list its files.

box-exhausted.speaker: FIXER
pages: That junction box under the VERIFY sign belongs to the Registry. Older than you.
That's all I know. The rest is yours.

box-broke.speaker: FIXER
pages: That junction box under the VERIFY sign belongs to the Registry. Older than you.
No tokens, no hints. Noodles aren't free twice.

install-hint-0.speaker: FIXER

Found something on that box? Modules don't install themselves.

pages: The box went dark. Half the street noticed. Use what you took.

Admins write everything down. Read their notes.

pages: Legs. Good. Rooftops are where the Registry forgot to look.

pages: The Market is west. Their gate wants a scanner signature. That's tomorrow's problem.
One bowl. Here:
The gate wants a scanner signature. Nobody on this street has one. Nobody human.

pages: The Market is west. Their gate wants a scanner signature. That's tomorrow's problem.

Robots get their routes from DISPATCH. DISPATCH hides behind shields. Shields come down outside in.

before.speaker: HOODED STRANGER
pages: Not authenticated. Not my problem.

after.speaker: HOODED STRANGER
pages: A box on this street went dark.
Registry is sending a van. Wasn't you, right?

pigeon.speaker: HOODED STRANGER
pages: Billboard's showing a pigeon.
Best thing it ever ran.

before.speaker: UMBRELLA
pages: I don't see you. That's the deal.
Unless you're selling Registry Premium. Terms: forever. Cancellation: see Terms. I read them twice.

after.speaker: UMBRELLA
pages: Still nobody. A louder nobody, though.

before.speaker: MAN IN A HAT
pages: Keep walking, ghost.

after.speaker: MAN IN A HAT
pages: Heard the noodle guy talks to ghosts now.
Bad for business. His, not mine.
